quarterly_data.quarter: Nagase & Co. results briefing: FY2026 First Quarter Financial Briefing (08-04-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nagase ChemteX Group: operating income from formulated epoxy resins increased; LMC (liquid molding compound) sales of products for AI semiconductors increased while sales for mobile devices declined. a-SMC (advanced sheet molding compound) has been adopted as an encapsulant for high-performance IC package substrates used in advanced semiconductors, and small-volume production has begun. Group Q1 sales 102 vs 79, operating income 17 vs 9 (100 millions of yen).
